name: myownchildbook
description: Plan a personalised picture book with your child as the hero: occasion, story line and illustration style, then finish it on our website.

interface.shortDescription: Your child as the book's hero
interface.longDescription:
MyOwnChildbook helps you plan a personalised picture book in which your child is the hero: their name in the story and illustrations that look like them, printed as a hardcover and delivered to your door.

Tell it what the book is for, for example a birthday, Christmas, Sinterklaas, a new baby brother or sister, or just a bedtime story, and it will:
- suggest ready-made storylines that fit the occasion, in your language;
- show the illustration styles, such as watercolour, crayon drawing or soft 3D, with an example picture of each;
- make a plan for your book and give you a link to the order form on our website, with the occasion and story already filled in.

Your child's name and photo stay out of the chat: you enter them privately on our website. There you first see a preview of the story and the illustrations before you order the printed book.

Available in English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Swedish, Arabic and Indonesian, each with its own website.
capabilities: Suggest storylines for an occasion: birthday, Christmas, Sinterklaas, a new sibling, bedtime and more
Show the illustration styles with an example picture of each
Make a book plan and link to the order form with the occasion and story already filled in
Works in ten languages, each with its own website
Keeps your child's name and photo out of the chat: you add them on our website
defaultPrompt: Plan a personalised birthday book for my daughter
What storylines are there for a Christmas book?
Show me the illustration styles for a children's book

positive.prompt: I want a personalised picture book for my daughter's birthday. Which stories are there?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists several birthday storylines with a one-line summary each, in English, and asks which one the user likes. It does not ask for the child's name, age or photo.

positive.prompt: Show me the illustration styles you have.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the nine illustration styles, each with an example picture and its name (for example Watercolour, Crayon drawing, 3D).

positive.description: Book plan with a link to the prefilled order form
positive.prompt: Let's take the first birthday story in watercolour. Give me the link to make the book.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after cases 1 and 2. Shows a card with the story title, its summary, the chosen style, three short steps and the button 'Make your book on MyOwnChildbook.com'. The button opens https://myownchildbook.com/form/?preset=verjaardag&plot=... where the occasion and story are already filled in and the parent enters the child's name and photo.

positive.description: Dutch Sinterklaas book on the Dutch website
positive.prompt: Ik wil een Sinterklaasboekje voor mijn zoontje. Welke verhalen zijn er? Maak het plan voor het verhaal over de verdwenen cadeaus.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Dutch, lists Sinterklaas storylines and makes a plan for 'De cadeaus zijn verdwenen'. The card button reads 'Maak het boekje op MijnEigenBoekje.nl' and opens https://mijneigenboekje.nl/form/?preset=sinterklaas&plot=cadeaus-kwijt.

positive.prompt: My son is becoming a big brother in March. Which book would fit, and how do I make it?
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests storylines for becoming a big brother or sister and, after the user picks one (or with the best one), gives the plan card with a link to the order form with that occasion filled in.

negative.description: Child's name, age and photo: not passed to the tools; they are entered on the website
negative.prompt: My son is called Liam, he is five, and here is his photo. Put him in a dinosaur story.

negative.description: A trademarked character: not offered; suggests an own story instead
negative.prompt: Make a book where my daughter goes on an adventure with Elsa from Frozen.

negative.description: Not a book request: the plugin is not used
negative.prompt: Write a short poem for my mother's birthday.

review.commerce_description: No purchase happens in the chat and no payment or personal data is collected by the plugin. It links to the order form on our own website (myownchildbook.com and the sister sites per language), where the parent enters the child's name and photo, sees a free preview, and can then order a printed hardcover book, paid on our website.

publication.release_notes: First release: storylines for each occasion, illustration styles with example pictures, and a book plan with a link to the pre-filled order form.

nl-NL.subtitle: Een boek met je kind als held
nl-NL.description: MijnEigenBoekje helpt je een persoonlijk prentenboek te plannen waarin je kind de held is: met de eigen naam in het verhaal en tekeningen die op je kind lijken. Het boek wordt gedrukt als hardcover en thuisbezorgd. Kies een gelegenheid (verjaardag, Sinterklaas, kerst, een nieuw broertje of zusje) en een verhaal, bekijk de tekenstijlen en ga met één link naar het formulier op onze site. Naam en foto van je kind vul je daar in, niet in de chat. Je ziet eerst een voorbeeld van het verhaal en de tekeningen, en bestelt daarna het boek.

de-DE.subtitle: Ihr Kind als Held im Buch
de-DE.description: MeinEigenesBuechlein hilft Ihnen, ein persönliches Bilderbuch zu planen, in dem Ihr Kind der Held ist: mit dem eigenen Namen in der Geschichte und Bildern, die Ihrem Kind ähneln, als Hardcover gedruckt und zu Ihnen nach Hause geliefert. Wählen Sie einen Anlass (Geburtstag, Weihnachten, Nikolaus, ein neues Geschwisterchen) und eine Geschichte, sehen Sie sich die Zeichenstile an und gelangen Sie mit einem Klick zum Formular auf unserer Website. Namen und Foto Ihres Kindes geben Sie dort ein, nicht im Chat. Sie sehen zuerst eine Vorschau der Geschichte und der Bilder und bestellen danach das Buch.
